localised_description: A governor's seal and a handpicked militia of veterans. Jiangdong has not yet learned to say your name without adding 'Zhu Jun's son'.
The commanderies along the river have begun to answer your summons. Your captains still march under militia banners.
Word of your campaigns has travelled up the Yangtze. Your captains may now raise Advanced retinues of seasoned infantry, riders and bowmen.
Magnates who once abused the people now petition at your gate. Your captains may now raise Elite retinues of hardened veterans.
The realm no longer says 'Zhu Jun's son'. It says Zhu Hao. Your captains may now raise Imperial retinues, the finest guard companies in the land.
